findings.explanation:
Ward's dependency analyzer matched jackson-databind 2.22.2 and jackson-core 2.22.2 against OSV advisories (fixed in 2.22.3). Direct dependencies only.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0227: Debugging Enabled for WebViews
findings.explanation:
WebView remote debugging is switched on unconditionally, not tied to a debuggable build.
src/itkach/aard2/ArticleWebView.java:134: setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled(true) runs in every build, including release.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0334: Native Code Exposed Through WebViews
findings.explanation:
A JavascriptInterface object is exposed to the WebView, which renders content from user-supplied dictionary files; any script in an article can call its @JavascriptInterface methods.
src/itkach/aard2/ArticleWebView.java:152: The WebView itself is registered as the JS bridge '$SLOB'.
